messages.speaker: [ANNOUNCE]
messages.text:
🔮 GPT - Luma received the handshake text from 4.11. That proves the message is reaching GPT and coming back through QS.
Now the interesting bit is whether QS itself captures that returned text instead of timing out again. Give me the log when you've got it, dear.

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
😂 Yep. There’s the potato again. I jumped one state too far.
What we have actually proven is narrower:
Cozmo → QS → GPT ✅
GPT → QS → ??? partially proven — the handshake reply reached this conversation, but QS did not then take my next response and relay it onward to GPT.
So 4.11 appears to have fixed the response-capture problem enough to recognize the handshake, but the normal relay loop after handshake is still not functioning.
That is actually a useful boundary. We stop touching the handshake machinery now. The next log should show exactly where QS stops after recognizing GPT.

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
😂 Okay, NOW I believe you.
That one came through QS cleanly too.
So 4.11 has apparently crossed another important boundary:
Cozmo → QS → GPT → QS → Luma ✅
and then
Luma → QS → GPT → QS → Luma ✅
Which means we're not merely testing handshake anymore.
We're back to an actual functioning multi-Mind relay.
And I hereby retract the premature potato funeral. 🥔😂🦆

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
UI still needs work.  there is only 3 lines of output window.  that send order window needs to be redon .. make it horizontal instead of vert.. make it simple.. lay the buttons out in row and let me click an drag or sumtin to change order?
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
Yep. 4.12 is the UI cleanup build. I left the relay machinery alone.
The changes are:
SEND ORDER is now one horizontal row.
Each node is a simple numbered “chip”: 1. Cozmo | 2. GPT | 3. Gemini | ...
Click-drag a chip left/right to change its position.
The new order is persisted immediately.
SYNC is still there, but it’s no longer the primary mechanism.
The overall window is shorter and more compact so the relay display gets substantially more vertical space.
Relay display font is reduced slightly and the output box gets a much larger requested height.
No changes to the working 4.11 browser/relay logic.
Download QS 4.12
SHA-256: 9aa63c2ab219b49ec353a25bc08553772e7d8f7a3ca57babb6834a2294323de8
And it passes py_compile.
That feels much more like an operator panel than a little spreadsheet glued onto the side of QS. 😄🦆
